Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Views

景色

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you like taking pictures of different views?

Yes, I love it. Different views, whether it's the sea, mountains or city streets, each have their own charm, so I like capturing them. My phone album is basically full of travel views and random shots I've taken.

喜欢拍不同景色，海、山、城市街道各有各的美。

Q2Do you prefer views in urban areas or rural areas?

I prefer urban views, honestly. Skyscrapers, night lights and modern architecture give me a real sense of technology and progress, which I find exciting. Rural views are peaceful, but they don't impress me as much.

更喜欢城市景色，高楼夜景有科技感。

Q3Do you prefer views in your own country or in other countries?

Views in other countries, to be fair. Foreign cities have this vintage, old-fashioned feel, like old European streets, that you don't really see in China. That contrast with what I'm used to makes them more appealing.

更喜欢国外景色，欧洲老街道很复古，国内看不到。

Q4Have you seen an unforgettable and beautiful view or scenery?

Yeah, I have. The sunset over the sea at Qianhai, near where I live, was unforgettable. The whole sky turned orange and pink, and the sea reflected it beautifully. I still remember standing there, completely amazed.

前海的海边日落很美，天空橙粉一片，难以忘怀。
